metadata.title: Mid-Century Holiday Vocal Group Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 1950s holiday aesthetic featuring a trio of performers in coordinated teal outfits against a soft-focus bokeh background with a decorated evergreen tree.
triggerTerms: vintage teal and pink holiday design

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring three female vocalists in the lower left, wearing teal satin dresses with white fur collars. To the right, a densely decorated Christmas tree stands vertically. The background is a soft-focus 'bokeh' of white and green ornaments. The top section contains dynamic pink script and bold white sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of the three subjects in the lower left quadrant
Vertical balance between the subjects and the Christmas tree on the right
Color harmony between the teal garments and the cool-toned background bokeh
Contrast between the fluid pink script and the rigid white block lettering
coreInvariants: Teal and white fur costume coordination
Diagonal placement of script text in the upper left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects clustered in the bottom-left, occupying approximately 40% of the frame; Christmas tree occupies the right third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central performer's face and the bright white fur collars.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the pink script top-left, moves down to the performers' faces, then across to the decorated tree on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the upper-middle area through soft-focus bokeh to allow text to breathe.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (fur collars, ornaments, and block text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, medium-saturation palette with bright highlights and soft shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of a fluid, upright formal script and a heavy, geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script features high contrast and connected glyphs with elegant loops
Sans-serif features thick, uniform strokes with tight apertures
characterSpecificRedesigns: Sans-serif 'M' and 'G' have sharp, square terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for emotive greeting paired with heavy sans-serif for performer names.
graphicDevices: Soft drop shadows on white text for legibility
Thin white outlines on pink script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century brush script feel

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Franklin Gothic Heavy or Futura Extra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric presence of the name text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1950s style photograph of three women in teal satin dresses with white fur collars, positioned bottom-left. Include a decorated Christmas tree on the right and a soft-focus bokeh background of ornaments.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add magenta-pink script text in the upper left at a slight upward angle. Add heavy white sans-serif block text in the center-right with a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Check for teal and white fur costume coordination
Ensure script text is pink with a white outline
Verify the presence of a decorated tree on the right side
Confirm the background is a soft-focus bokeh effect

adjustableVariables: Density of the Christmas tree decorations

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp typography over soft backgrounds

postGenerationChecks: Is the script text angled upwards?
Are the fur collars bright white and distinct?
Does the teal color dominate the lower half of the image?
Is the tree on the right side of the frame?
Is the typography legible against the background?
recipe.reuseFormula: 1950s Vocal Group + Teal/Pink Palette + Bokeh Background + Script/Sans-Serif Pairing
